deep.reconstruction:
This page finishes a computation begun on the previous page. Setting: f is an entire function with zeros of moduli r_ν. n(r) counts the zeros with |z| < r. V(r) = (1/2π)∫_0^{2π} log|f(re^{iφ})| dφ is the circular mean of log|f|.

Previous page:
- Jensen's relation r V'(r) = n(r) (a.e.) gives, after integration by parts against a weight μ, the identity ∫_a^b n μ dr = [rμV]_a^b − ∫_a^b V d(rμ).
- With μ = −λ' and Stieltjes integration ∑_{a<r_ν<b} λ(r_ν) = ∫_a^b λ dn = [λn]_a^b + ∫ nμ dr, this becomes ∑_{a<r_ν<b} λ(r_ν) = λ(b)n(b−0) − λ(a)n(a+0) − [rλ'(r)V(r)]_a^b + ∫_a^b V d(rλ').

This page:
1. It lets a → 0 under the normalisation |f(0)| = 1 and a decay hypothesis on μ near 0. The result is ∑_{r_ν<b} λ(r_ν) = λ(b) n(b−0) − bλ'(b)V(b) + ∫_0^b V(r) d(rλ'(r)).
2. It then notes that V is controlled by the maximum modulus M(r) = sup_{|z|=r}|f(z)|. Hence the weighted counting integral ∫_a^b n(r)μ(r) dr, and thus weighted sums ∑λ(r_ν) over the zeros, are bounded in terms of M(r).

This is the standard route from the growth of an entire function to the distribution of its zeros: weighted Jensen/Nevanlinna counting.

What it serves: the next page studies entire functions of genus zero f(z) = ∏(1 + λ_i z), (λ_i) ∈ ℓ^1, and their coefficients α_n(λ). These are exactly Fredholm determinants det(1 + zu) of nuclear operators. The page is a lemma-level tool for Grothendieck's 1953–55 Fredholm theory: estimating eigenvalue sums (zeros of the determinant) from growth bounds on the determinant.
errors: The bound should read 0 ≤ V(r) ≤ log M(r), not |V(r)| ≤ M(r). As written it is true but very weak (since log M ≤ M). When |f(0)| = 1, Jensen's formula gives V(r) = ∑_{r_ν<r} log(r/r_ν) ≥ 0 and V nondecreasing, so V ≤ log M(r) is the sharp form. Either a 'log' was omitted or M was meant to be log sup|f|.

The hypothesis r²μ(r) → 0 as r → 0 is superfluous here (or at least not the natural one). With |f(0)| = 1, V(r) ≡ 0 and n(r) ≡ 0 on [0, min r_ν), so all boundary terms at 0 vanish without any condition on μ. A condition such as rμ(r)V(r) → 0 would be the relevant one in general.
The sign before bλ'(b)V(b) is obscured by an ink blot; from the previous page's formula it must be '−'.

ideas.what: Weighted Jensen formula: ∑_{r_ν<b} λ(r_ν) expressed through the circular mean V(r) of log|f| by Stieltjes integration by parts
ideas.modern_name: Jensen's formula / Nevanlinna counting function identity N(r) = ∫ n(t)/t dt = V(r) − log|f(0)| with general weights
ideas.where_published: Possibly used implicitly in 'La théorie de Fredholm' (Bull. SMF 84, 1956) for eigenvalue/growth estimates of Fredholm determinants; not verified

ideas.what: Bounding weighted zero-counting sums by the maximum modulus M(r)
ideas.modern_name: Zero-distribution estimates from growth (order/genus theory, Weyl–Carleman-type eigenvalue bounds via determinants)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Hadamard, Borel, Lindelöf; for operators, Carleman / Weyl / Grothendieck
ideas.where_published: Related material in 'La théorie de Fredholm' (1956) and Produits tensoriels topologiques (Memoirs AMS 16, 1955), Ch. II

deep.surprise_reason: This is a textbook weighted Jensen formula plus the observation that zero sums are controlled by M(r). It is scratch work toward Fredholm-determinant estimates that Grothendieck did publish. There is nothing new, and there are minor slips (log omitted, a superfluous hypothesis).
transcription_corrections: 'λ(b) u(b−0)' should read 'λ(b) n(b−0)' (n, the counting function).
The blotted symbol before 'bλ'(b)V(b)' is a minus sign.
'∫_a^b u(r)μ(r) dr' should read '∫_a^b n(r)μ(r) dr'; the lower limit may be 0 or a.
'comme |V(r)| ≤ M(r) = Sup_{|z|=r}|f(z)|' — the leading word 'comme' is correct. Mathematically the bound should involve log M(r).
The final line reads 'de M(r)' ('en fonction de M(r)').
